description: The plot illustrates accuracy values across a set of x-axis parameter settings, showing three series: Final Accuracy, Initial Accuracy, and the change in accuracy (Δ Accuracy). The x-axis is unlabeled and uses a linear scale with discrete tick labels ranging from 0.71 to 1.00 (values shown include 0.71, 0.73, 0.79, 0.82, 0.83, 0.85, 0.86, 0.87, 0.90, 0.91, 0.92, 0.93, 0.94, 0.95, 0.96, 0.97, 0.98, 0.99, 1.00), with irregular spacing between labeled ticks. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, and shows regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The Final Accuracy series is a blue solid line with circular markers and error bars; it starts near 0.90 at x=0.71, dips to about 0.73 at x=0.73, rises to about 1.00 at x=0.79, then stays mostly between roughly 0.88 and 1.00 through x=1.00, reaching about 1.00 again around x=0.91 and x=0.97 and ending near 0.98 at x=1.00. The Δ Accuracy series is an orange dashed line with diamond markers and error bars; it begins around 0.36 at x=0.71, drops to about 0.10 at x=0.73, remains near ~0.08–0.30 across mid-range x values (e.g., about 0.25 at x=0.82 and about 0.29 at x=0.83), peaks around 0.45 at x=0.87, falls to about 0.04 at x=0.90, shows additional higher points around 0.41 at x=0.91 and about 0.45 at x=0.94, and ends near 0.08 at x=1.00. The Initial Accuracy series is a green dash-dot line with square markers and error bars; it starts around 0.55 at x=0.71, increases to about 0.63 at x=0.73 and about 0.92 at x=0.79, drops to about 0.70 at x=0.82 and about 0.64 at x=0.83, rises to around 0.78 at x=0.85 and about 0.73 at x=0.86, dips to about 0.45 at x=0.87, rises to about 0.83 at x=0.90, fluctuates between roughly 0.47 and 0.83 from x=0.91 to x=0.99 (including about 0.59 at x=0.91 and about 0.47 at x=0.94), and ends near 0.90 at x=1.00.
